text: Casey, one thing we didn't close yesterday: required profile fields at signup. From the flow we agreed, they never hit Northstar signup. Apex creates the account. We cannot require those fields on our form.

Mapped both paths: new applicant and migrated member, start to finish. Please sanity-check before we lock copy. Also need sample wording for Create password vs Reset password. You said other customers phrase this differently.

Workstreams look good. PulseMail says Create your password. The Northstar screen and system email still say reset. We cannot set a password for them. Same mechanics for migrated and new. Tone should differ. Migrated: skip Northstar welcome so PulseMail owns first touch. New applicants: Northstar welcome on, plus complete profile.
CSV of blogs and on-demand webinars attached. Confirming your team uploads? Do we need the blog page finalized first? Also, can we refresh older posts before launch?
Your note said: can the logged-in state score be future state or is it needed for MVP? What does that mean in practice?

Once a virtual event wraps, what happens to the landing page? Ideal: transcript plus recording, recording moves into Perspectives as on demand, we write a recap. Can we embed without an unlisted YouTube? Does the event page just turn into a post?
Don't we want the video as On Demand in the events section, not only as a blog?

There is a video-on-demand feature. It is not finished. Checking whether the current beta helps. Today: event ends, recording lands in a wrap-up tab. To show it, you upload to YouTube or Vimeo and paste the link. We cannot embed a raw file.
What is the wrap-up tab? We have not accounted for that. We need an on-demand card in events and separately a recap post if we write one.

Transparently, we are struggling on scoping and what the platform offers out of the box. We didn't even think to ask what happens after an event airs. Are there walkthroughs of features as if you were showing capabilities, not 40-minute how-tos?
I need a firm MVP list for the next two weeks. Slack is fine for quick answers. For project management, please keep open questions in the shared briefing doc.
API flows are connected. Green light to put our PulseMail credentials in settings?
Event types: Whiteboard always private. Hot Takes, Behind the Build, On the Record, In Person can be private or public. Watercooler always private.
Lock it: two PulseMail workstreams, one shared password CTA. Platform never sets the password. After reset, no extra you-did-it email from us. Login is the next step.
When do we get a branded version of the site we can actually look at?
Alex and I made test events. Types named members vs public. Validate in incognito. You will still need the staging gate until go-live.
After someone resets and logs in the first time, what kicks off the welcome look around email? I think Northstar cannot auto-send that. Can PulseMail?
Agent connector is on for this instance. Read and write. Break things now, not after go-live. Everything is fixable.
On event landing pages, are You'll walk away with and What you'll learn required, or was that sample text?
Confirming we do NOT want the Figma logged-in homepage forums block live on day one?
We are planning 1-2 discussions live on the homepage day of.
Two MVP options then: recap post with unlisted video, or a separate On Demand event. Future state hopefully just flips to on demand. Fine until VOD is real.
Site styled v1. Custom pages later today. All QA in the tracker tab, not here. Feedback by 5 PT Thursday if we want changes by Monday.

I am a little lost on Forums. Homepage lists our blogs. Community Discussions has one thread. Can we remove blogs from that widget? I published three posts and cannot find them. Can we lock new posts to admins only?
We will need lists of people who have and have not reset their password, with timestamps. Same for first login. How?
Originally we were going to use the Northstar welcome once a user is created. Somewhere along the line we decided PulseMail owns it.
I still think native welcome / reset emails from Northstar make sense. It is just a toggle.

Nav Perspectives now goes to /blogs. Homepage forum widget is discussions only. Confirming you want Parent Perspectives gone, and articles, playbooks, spotlights, recaps plus Discussions all under forums.
Design needs blog header sizes tonight. Please look at the Figma vs what is possible. Right now we feel far apart. That blocks the asset request.

When I click Join it opens the live room and I get a confirmation email, but the event is in three days. Also I made a test event and it is not on the events page. And there are three different email admin screens. I am confused.

You are on an admin account. Admins can join early. RSVP on a dummy member. Ticket confirmation is System email. Reminders are Automated. Chapter newsletters are a third place. We cannot send mail on first login.
If someone shares an event URL while logged out they still see the content and the button says log in to register. Same for Perspectives. Is that the experience we want?
I am getting lost on what automated email Northstar can do vs what must live in PulseMail. Can we get 30 minutes Monday to align?
Contributor page: SiteBlocks cannot store form submissions yet. To keep MVP, put the form in PulseMail or similar and send the embed. We will place it. Native forms are escalated.
If we use a generic form tool, companies that block it cannot submit. We have hit that before.
Homepage is still showing archived forum posts. Also please rename Forums to Discussions and change the button to See all posts.
Uploading events: Whiteboard has no people tab so I cannot add speakers. Behind the Build, Watercooler, and In Person are missing from the dropdown.
Need EOD: we could have sworn we could identify migrated vs not, and who has reset. That segmentation is load-bearing for the email flows.
Recap so we do not drown. Outstanding: blog dates back to original publish, field exec SSO steps, application page, footer, event templates. PulseMail welcome after login still on Elena.
PulseMail embed for contribute is ready. We also need a thank-you page.
We will not host thank-you as a native form result. These are PulseMail embeds. Thank-you should be a page we can redirect to, plus PulseMail can still email the applicant.
SOS: future events vanished from the homepage. I think we hid the chapter.
Pages with PulseMail: Contribute, Form, Apply Now. Watch Apply Now vs Form. If those should be the same application, say so. Thank-you application and thank-you contributor are redirect targets.
Confirm next steps for field executives. Pat should SSO today so they can post. The others need to sign in today if possible. What do I tell them?

We cannot send an email based on first login. PulseMail has to own that trigger. System ticket confirmation is the register email. Reminders are Automated, trigger Event Start minus 7 days and minus 1 day.
Logged-out QA: RSVP says general admission which is wrong for virtual. Contribute should not show logged out. Assessment header copy is stale.
Staging gate is a shared site lock. It is not the member password we send in reset mail. Different on purpose.

Given current status, public launch moves. We will still turn the site live in the morning as planned, but we will not send invites until field executives can test and our team can get in. Please confirm seen.
SSO is failing after the domain change. Apex GateSSO app needs redirect_uri updated to whitelist forgex.io.

New launch plan: tomorrow soft launch to 200-250 inactive members. Next day social plus email to current members excluding the soft list. Day after, second touch split active vs inactive.

Can we eventually have On Demand as a category? Remind me where recordings live in the plan.

619 visits today. 381 new user visits. 59 logged in users.

Define using the last two days. Page views = who hit forgex.io. Total users = whole migrated community, reset or not. New users = ? Logged in = reset password and actually logged in. When I download logged-in users it does not look like user data.

Public events: create Open to the Public category, duplicate the event, funnel both regs to the same live URL? Hide that category from homepages? Can we use that landing URL in promo?

Alex and Jordan are out. I am in back to backs. Can you open the metrics hub Jordan stood up?
I have 45 minutes. Join when you can.
